# Elizabeth Plumbing Pros

> Elizabeth Plumbing Pros is a local plumbing referral network and educational resource serving homeowners and property managers in Elizabeth, New Jersey and surrounding Union County communities. The platform connects consumers with independent, qualified plumbing contractors and publishes verified diagnostic guides.

## Core Information
- Website: https://elizabethplumbingpros.com
- Primary Phone: (908) 738-8526 (tel:+19087388526)
- Primary Market: Elizabeth, New Jersey (Union County)
- Operating Model: Telephony referral network connecting consumers with independent local plumbing professionals. Free service to homeowners.
- Target Locations: Elizabeth (07201, 07202, 07206, 07207, 07208), Union Township (07083), Westfield (07090, 07091), Cranford (07016), Roselle (07203), Fanwood (07023).

## Plumbing Services
- [Emergency Plumbing](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/emergency-plumbing-elizabeth-nj): Urgent assistance for sudden leaks, ruptured lines, wastewater overflows, and flooding in Elizabeth.
- [Drain Cleaning](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/drain-cleaning-elizabeth-nj): Mechanical snaking and motorized augering for clogged kitchen, bath, and main drain lines.
- [Water Heater Repair](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/water-heater-repair-elizabeth-nj): Troubleshooting inconsistent hot water, tank rumbling, burner failures, and leaking valves.
- [Water Heater Installation](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/water-heater-installation-elizabeth-nj): Professional replacement and sizing for gas, electric, and tankless water heaters.
- [Leak Detection](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/leak-detection-elizabeth-nj): Non-invasive acoustic, thermal, and pressure testing for concealed supply pipe leaks.
- [Pipe Repair](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/pipe-repair-elizabeth-nj): Repair and repiping for frozen, corroded, pinhole, copper, PEX, and cast-iron pipes.
- [Sewer Line Repair](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/sewer-line-repair-elizabeth-nj): Video camera inspection, root intrusion removal, and trenchless/traditional sewer line repair.
- [Toilet Repair](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/toilet-repair-elizabeth-nj): Fixing running flappers, slow fills, bowl clogs, cracked wax rings, and loose flanges.
- [Faucet Repair](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/faucet-repair-elizabeth-nj): Cartridge, valve stem, aerator, and seal replacements for dripping kitchen and bath faucets.
- [Garbage Disposal Repair](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/garbage-disposal-repair-elizabeth-nj): Clearing jammed impellers, electrical reset diagnostics, and disposal replacements.
- [Sump Pump Services](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/sump-pump-services-elizabeth-nj): Primary submersible pump service, float switch testing, and battery backup installation.
- [Clogged Drain Repair](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/services/clogged-drain-repair-elizabeth-nj): Fast-action clearing for localized slow or standing water obstructions.

## Authoritative Educational Guides
- [7 Signs of a Hidden Plumbing Leak](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/blog/signs-of-hidden-plumbing-leak): Technical guide to acoustic leak detection, water meter tests, drywall moisture thresholds, and foundation protection.
- [What to Do When a Pipe Bursts](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/blog/what-to-do-when-pipe-bursts): Immediate step-by-step emergency checklist for shutting off main water, line depressurization, and electrical safety.
- [Causes of Slow Drains & Prevention](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/blog/common-causes-slow-drains-prevention): Understanding FOG buildup, hair accumulation, biological enzyme treatments, and proper drain maintenance.
- [Signs Your Water Heater May Need Repair](https://elizabethplumbingpros.com/blog/signs-water-heater-needs-repair): Diagnosing sediment rumbling, sacrificial anode depletion, rusty water, and TPR valve leaks.
